shared_elements: repeated row of vertical strokes forming a band
justification: Both surfaces show anthropomorphic figures with arms raised holding a handled object, and both include a horizontal band of repeated short vertical strokes (an inscription line versus a crew-stroke boat), but these are generic coincidences. A is a densely detailed, naturalistically modelled symmetrical composition of winged bearded attendants flanking an elaborate stylised tree, while B consists of sparse, wholly schematic stick-like silhouettes, a small quadruped and a boat scattered on an open field, with no shared specific motif or relationship.
